chunks: And with this chain of narration, from Ali (peace be upon him), regarding the saying of Allah, the Exalted and Mighty: 'And to Him belong the ships raised high in the sea like mountains,' he said: 'The ships.'

key_terms.الْمُنْشَآتُ: Those raised high or built up (referring to the height of ships)

ai.seo_question: What does the Quranic term 'Al-Jawari al-Munsha'at' refer to according to Shia tradition?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Uyun Akhbar al-Rida*, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) elucidates the term 'Al-Jawari al-Munsha'at' in Surah Ar-Rahman as ships, highlighting the divine creation of maritime vessels. This interpretation underscores the Quranic theme of Allah’s power over the seas, a motif frequently echoed in Shia exegesis to demonstrate God's mastery over natural elements for human benefit.
